page.text:
Now we have the machinery in place to describe our first theorem, which
is a statement that can be proven.

```mlg
Theorem:
given:
. C is \set
. B \:subset:/ C
. A \:subset:/ B
then:
. A \:subset?:/ C
Id: "6a4bcb50-97bc-4d1b-a9b2-750c963bb720"
```

The `Theorem:` construct is used to communicate theorems, where the
`given:` section represents the *inputs* to the theorem and the `then:`
section describes the results of the theorem.
